newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Norscan stocks likely to fall in April-Momentum.
newsitem.headline: Norscan stocks likely to fall in April-Momentum.

text.p: Swedish consulting group Momentum said on Tuesday good conditions existed for a sharp downturn in Norscan stocks in April.
"Considering the number of maintenance stops in April, combined with good deliveries, people can count on a downturn in inventories," Swedish consultancy group Momentum spokesman Bernt Stenberg said.
Portuguese pulp group Portucel said earlier it believed there had been a sharp drop in NorScan pulp stocks in April that could have been more than 200,000 tonnes.
"The estimation given by Portucel is not too high, but probably the opposite," he said.
Stenberg said shipments of pulp in March were 20 percent above January and February levels.
"According to our reports, April (shipments) are stronger than March," said Stenberg. He said April deliveries were at least the equivalent of full capacity utilisation.
NorScan (North American and Scandinavian) stocks fell between 140,000 and 160,000 tonnes in March.
